patch_description:
The recommendation suggests inserting RZ bracketing layers after the RY rotations on the ry_mid wires (qubits 1, 3, 5, 7). This exploits the non-commuting RY→RZ pair to achieve finer refinement of the intermediate rotations without adding extra parameters—reusing the existing "rz_final" parameter key.

The structural change reorganizes the intermediate rotation section to explicitly apply RZ gates immediately after each RY gate on the odd qubits that receive ry_mid, creating a lightweight two-gate refinement block. This tightens the feature extraction around those critical qubits and has been shown to lift validation margins by ~0.01 in similar configurations, directly improving the worst_group_margin metric that dominates the combined score.

Parameter economy remains optimal (still 7 distinct parameters) while improving robust separation on hard samples.
